joint-validation.scope: The five existing strontium contrasts are scored together. The upper spacing contributed to the initial mode assignment. The clock measurement is used for scoring and for reporting which contrast passes. Contrast is local to the strontium mass operator. It is separate from the six assembly coordinates. Reusing the same strontium readout for the 576 rows tests coexistence; it does not test a shared law for this coefficient in other domains.

thermal_atlas.result: Passed isotope/ion counts and independent frame export settings, four crystal motifs, two camera axes and phase-specific spectroscopy including six water and ice path lengths.

regenerated_field_from_long_mode.components: Full N72 reference trajectory, including driven and background histories, and 12 zero-defect wave grids up to N551. Each component was regenerated from its initial conditions.

archived_shear_timeseries_reanalysis.procedure: Run code/cisaillement.py --complet --reprise with the 24 supplied CSV histories. The forces are not reintegrated in this check. The regenerated Green–Kubo and Helfand table equals the archived JSON after parsing.

offline_chromium.controls: Neutral, isotope, ion, thermal, sky, gravity, bidirectional language controls and full reference-GIF download.

scope: The standard replay checks the distributed scientific inputs and all stated section results. The long command regenerates the upstream fields, transport trajectories, and joint register from the archived initial conditions. Calibration, the scope of the existing controls, and the empirical requirements for electronic assignment and persistence of a person are specified in the manuscript.
